## Featured Case Studies & System Architectures

### 1. Edu Amicus — Cloud Migration & Production Deployment
- **URL:** https://adilrahman.cc/saas/edu-amicus-deployment
- **Architecture:** Production cloud architecture, SQLite-to-Supabase migration, and edge-proxied deployment on Railway & Cloudflare Pages. Engineered a custom Cloudflare Pages Functions edge proxy with sliding-window edge rate limiting and Cloudflare Edge Cache. Configured Supabase connection pooling with `pool_pre_ping=True` and `pool_recycle=300` to prevent transaction pooler timeouts.

### 2. AR Membership Manager — Multi-Tenant B2B Gym SaaS
- **URL:** https://adilrahman.cc/saas/membership-saas
- **Architecture:** Multi-tenant B2B subscription and member management platform built with Next.js, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS), and automated WhatsApp messaging via Meta Cloud API.

### 3. ZMR Music — YouTube Music Client
- **URL:** https://adilrahman.cc/saas/zmr
- **Architecture:** High-performance YouTube Music streaming client built in Flutter using Riverpod for immutable state management and `just_audio` with background isolates and lockscreen notification controls.

### 4. ViewPick — Movie Discovery PWA
- **URL:** https://adilrahman.cc/saas/viewpick
- **Architecture:** Interactive movie curation Progressive Web App built with Flutter Web, TMDB API, and Supabase, featuring a 60 FPS swipe interface and offline service worker caching.

### 5. Free ATS Resume & CV Builder
- **URL:** https://adilrahman.cc/tools/resume-builder
- **Architecture:** Client-side zero-dependency browser resume builder featuring live WYSIWYG editing, parser-safe single-column ATS export with custom section sequence badges, and instant localStorage persistence. 100% free, zero login, no watermark.
